# BreezingForms NG

> BreezingForms NG (com_breezingformsng) is a free, GPL form builder for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+.
> It is the community-maintained continuation of Crosstec BreezingForms: visual QuickMode editor,
> multi-page forms, visibility rules, file uploads, signatures, captcha/reCAPTCHA, email
> notifications, submission records with PDF/CSV/XLSX/XML export, Stripe/PayPal/Sofort payments,
> per-form PHP and JavaScript hooks, GDPR privacy plugin, and 8 languages.

Install from the GitHub releases through Joomla's extension installer. Embed a form with a menu
item, the `mod_breezingforms` module or the content plugin `{BreezingForms:FormName}`.
Existing BreezingForms (Crosstec) sites upgrade in place: data stays in the `#__facileforms_*` tables.

## Docs

- [Migrating BreezingForms to Joomla 6](https://breezingforms-ng.vcmb.fr/migrating-breezingforms-to-joomla-6): step-by-step upgrade guide for Crosstec BreezingForms sites
- [README](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/README.md): features, requirements, installation, upgrade
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/skills/breezingformsng/SKILL.md): building, embedding and scripting forms
- [Element types](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/skills/breezingformsng/references/elements.md): QuickMode elements, themes, visibility rule syntax
- [Scripting reference](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/skills/breezingformsng/references/scripting.md): JS/PHP hooks, `ff_*` functions, variables in scope
- [Upgrading from BreezingForms](https://github.com/vcmb-cyclo/com_breezingformsng/blob/main/skills/breezingformsng/references/migration.md): what the installer migrates, what to check
